cards.title: Continuation for this programme's clients
intro: What happens to this programme's clients when their class ends?
Decide what should happen after a class ends. For group classes, you can suggest which classes students should continue in. For individual sessions, they can simply sign up again.

fields.label: Auto-enrolment type
options: Suggest classes — We’ll show clients a set of suitable classes based on your criteria. If they choose to continue, they can enrol in one with a single click—no need to fill in their details again.
Duplicate current class — For 1-to-1 classes only: When a client agrees to continue, Zooza will prepare an identical version of the current class for the future. You just review and approve.

fields.label: Notify the client N days before the class ends
fields.help: The client will get an email letting them know the class is ending. They can then choose their next class directly from their profile.

fields.label: Keep client in auto-enrolment for N days
fields.help: The client will see the auto-enrolment offer in their profile for the specified number of days. Set this to 0 to use the default value (30 days).

fields.label: Auto-enrollment message
fields.help: This message will be sent to the client as a notification that their group is ending and auto-enrolment is available.

cards.title: What your auto-enrolment clients are shown
intro: When this programme's clients are in auto-enrolment, which classes are they shown?

These settings apply to this programme's own clients once their class ends and they enter auto-enrolment. They filter which classes (offered by any programme) those clients are shown. They have no effect on clients coming from other programmes.
Programme, billing period, distance and age

A client of this programme finishes their class and enters auto-enrolment. The settings here filter what they are shown: if a class requires age 5 and the child is 4, that class is hidden, so the client only sees classes they are eligible for.
Narrows which classes this programme's clients are shown once they are in auto-enrolment.
These settings define which classes this programme's clients are shown once they enter auto-enrolment. Use them to narrow the options by programme, billing period, age, or distance.

fields.label: Show only classes in these billing periods
fields.help: Your auto-enrolment clients are only shown classes that belong to one of these billing periods.

fields.label: Show only classes from these programmes
fields.help: Your auto-enrolment clients are only shown classes from one of these programmes.

fields.label: Distance
fields.help: This will limit offered classes based on distance to the venue the client is currently enrolled in. Distance is in kilometers.

cards.title: Classes you offer into auto-enrolment
intro: Which of this programme's classes are offered to clients in auto-enrolment?

Select which of this programme's classes are offered to clients in auto-enrolment, including clients coming from other programmes. Each programme enables its own classes here, and this works whether or not this programme runs its own auto-enrolment. To let clients only pre-order a class, disable its online booking.

fields.label: Show nicknames only
fields.help: When active, clients can only see the nickname.
